cite.original: To dream of quilts, foretells pleasant and comfortable circumstances.
cite.translation_ko: 솜이불 꿈은, 즐겁고 편안한 형편의 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 실속 있고 지혜로운 살림 솜씨로 아내로 맞으려는 이의 호감을 얻을 조짐
interpretation_en: this dream foretells that her practical and wise business-like ways will advance her into the favorable esteem of a man who will seek her for a wife

cite.original: For a young woman, this dream foretells that her practical and wise business-like ways will advance her into the favorable esteem of a man who will seek her for a wife.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 솜이불 꿈을 꾸면, 실속 있고 지혜로운 살림 솜씨로 아내로 맞으려는 이의 호감을 얻을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 제 값어치를 알아주는 남편을 얻지만, 가장 바라던 짝은 아닐 조짐
interpretation_en: she will win a husband who appreciates her worth, but he will not be the one most desired by her for a companion

cite.original: If the quilts are clean, but having holes in them, she will win a husband who appreciates her worth, but he will not be the one most desired by her for a companion.
cite.translation_ko: 깨끗하지만 구멍 난 솜이불을 보는 꿈은, 제 값어치를 알아주는 남편을 얻지만, 가장 바라던 짝은 아닐 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 옷차림과 몸가짐이 조심성 없다는 증거가 되어, 훌륭한 남편을 얻는 데 실패할 조짐
interpretation_en: she will bear evidence of carelessness in her dress and manners, and thus fail to secure a very upright husband

cite.original: If the quilts are soiled, she will bear evidence of carelessness in her dress and manners, and thus fail to secure a very upright husband.
cite.translation_ko: 더러운 솜이불을 보는 꿈은, 옷차림과 몸가짐이 조심성 없다는 증거가 되어, 훌륭한 남편을 얻는 데 실패할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 머잖아 큰 행복을 누리겠지만, 재물 쪽 전망은 빈약할 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes you will soon be possessed of great happiness, though your prospects for much wealth may be meager

cite.original: To dream of quinine, denotes you will soon be possessed of great happiness, though your prospects for much wealth may be meager.
cite.translation_ko: 키니네 꿈은, 머잖아 큰 행복을 누리겠지만, 재물 쪽 전망은 빈약할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 건강과 기력이 나아지고, 사업에 도움 될 새 벗도 사귈 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells improvement in health and energy. You will also make new friends, who will lend you commercial aid

cite.original: To take some, foretells improvement in health and energy. You will also make new friends, who will lend you commercial aid.
cite.translation_ko: 키니네를 먹는 꿈은, 건강과 기력이 나아지고, 사업에 도움 될 새 벗도 사귈 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of being afflicted with this disease, denotes discouraging employments.
cite.translation_ko: 편도염을 앓는 꿈은, 일이 힘 빠지게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_en: sickness will cause you much anxiety

cite.original: To see others with it, sickness will cause you much anxiety.
cite.translation_ko: 남이 편도염을 앓는 것을 보는 꿈은, 병으로 몹시 근심하게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 하찮은 약속과 좋은 일자리를 잃을 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells low engagements and loss of good employment

cite.original: To play at quoits in dreams, foretells low engagements and loss of good employment.
cite.translation_ko: 콰이츠 던지기를 하는 꿈은, 하찮은 약속과 좋은 일자리를 잃을 조짐이다

cite.original: To lose, portends of distressing conditions.
cite.translation_ko: 콰이츠 던지기에서 지는 꿈은, 괴로운 처지의 조짐이다
